title: commerce
description: Cross-merchant product search with real price history, comparisons, and demand signals.
summary: Cross-merchant product search with real price history, comparisons, and demand signals.
offersHint: Cross-merchant product search with real price history, comparisons, and demand signals. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://lmk.today/api/ucp/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search
toolsPreview.description: Search LMK products; returns citable results, each with a canonical LMK product-page URL. Use for shopping/discovery. For price/brand/on-sale filters, use search_catalog.

toolsPreview.name: fetch
toolsPreview.description: Fetch full detail for one product by id (from a prior search result). Returns citable text with price, savings, 90-day price history, and buying options.

toolsPreview.name: search_catalog
toolsPreview.description: Search LMK's curated cross-merchant catalog. Returns products with LMK product-page links. Use for "find me X" shopping queries.

toolsPreview.name: lookup_catalog
toolsPreview.description: Batch-resolve products by LMK slug, id, or external/merchant id.

toolsPreview.name: get_product
toolsPreview.description: Get a single product with full detail: enriched card, 90-day price stats (lowest/highest/average + is-at-lowest), and cross-merchant buying options.

toolsPreview.name: compare_prices
toolsPreview.description: Compare a product's price across merchants. Returns offers plus lowest/highest, all linking to the LMK product page.

toolsPreview.name: get_price_history
toolsPreview.description: Get price history and stats for a product over a trailing window (default 90 days). LMK-proprietary price intelligence.

toolsPreview.name: get_deals
toolsPreview.description: Today's best deals, ranked by LMK's deal-quality scoring (discount depth, price sweet spot, merchant quality). Optionally filter by category slug or minimum discount.

toolsPreview.name: get_popular_products
toolsPreview.description: Most-wishlisted products (180-day demand signal across all LMK lists, aggregate counts only). Unique LMK demand data.

toolsPreview.name: get_trending_products
toolsPreview.description: Products gaining momentum — most-added to wishlists in the last 30 days (aggregate counts only).

toolsPreview.name: get_gift_ideas
toolsPreview.description: Gift recommendations for a recipient/occasion within a budget. Blends curated search with LMK demand signals.

toolsPreview.name: list_collections
toolsPreview.description: List LMK's published editorial collections (occasions, holidays, beauty, style, sports).

toolsPreview.name: get_collection
toolsPreview.description: Get a single editorial collection and its curated products by slug.
